title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: GitHub Copilot Agent Tools now available in the AL Extension (New AL Tools Available for Agents)
summary: The pre-release AL Language extension now includes GitHub Copilot agent tools, such as al_build, al_download_symbols and al_publish, which let Copilot agent mode automate AL workflows. They appear in the extension's version 17.0 changelog but also work with runtime 16.0. They need VS Code 1.99 or later with agent mode enabled, and they are experimental.
key_points: GitHub Copilot agent tools were added to the AL VSIX so agent mode can automate AL development tasks
Tools shown include al_build, al_download_symbols and al_publish, and each call shows its input and output details
Listed in the AL extension version 17.0 changelog and tested with pre-release v17.0.1825603; they also work on runtime 16.0
Agent mode needs VS Code 1.99+, the chat.agent.enabled setting, and Agent selected in the Chat view
The tools are experimental and may change

quotes.text: These tools enable the GitHub Copilot agent mode to automate and orchestrate AL workflows, making development faster, smarter, and more flexible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit and purpose of the new agent tools for AL developers

quotes.text: Agent mode is available starting from VS Code 1.99.
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the minimum VS Code version requirement for using these tools

quotes.text: These tools are experimental and subject to change in future updates.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat about the stability and maturity of the feature
